description: Reconcile small PARTIALLY_PAID purchase-invoice currency residuals. DRY RUN by default; execute=true applies in-place fixes for <0.10 EUR or FX journals for 0.10-1.00 EUR.

execute.description: Apply the proposed fixes (default false = dry run)

fx_gain_account_id.description: Account for FX gains (diff > 0, paid less than booked) — default: auto-detect combined "Kasum/kahjum valuutakursi muutustest" (standard 8500)

fx_loss_account_id.description: Account for FX losses (diff < 0, paid more than booked) — default: same combined FX account as gains (standard 8500)

liability_accounts_id.description: Deprecated compatibility assertion. When supplied, it must match the invoice liability account; it never overrides or supplies that account.

max_candidates.description: Limit to first N PARTIALLY_PAID invoices

name: reconcile_currency_rounding
title: Reconcile Currency Rounding
